data.gender_notes: Kaushal is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Kaushal is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Kausala’, which means ‘expert’, ‘skilled’, or ‘wise’. In Hindu mythology, Kaushal is the name of several gods and heroes. For instance, Kaushal is a name of Lord Indra, the king of the gods, who is known for his bravery and wisdom. The name Kaushal carries the meaning “Expert, skilled” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kaushal usually hope their child will grow to embody expert, skilled and live with faith, good character and purpose.
